photos.name: img-7504
photos.summary: Top-down evening shot of bulk-fermenting dough in a glass Pyrex bowl on the kitchen counter — slack, wet surface with visible cheddar chunks and a few jalapeño bits embedded near the edges. Red Cambro lid in the corner of the frame.

photos.name: img-7506
photos.summary: Loaf 1 cooling on the copper round wire rack at the kitchen island, living room and wall art in the background — flour-dusted crown with a wide cheese-caramelization scar along the ear and a slightly squat profile.

photos.name: img-7507
photos.summary: Different angle on loaf 1 cooling on the copper rack — silicone pastry mat propped behind it as a backdrop, score split open to reveal pockets of melted cheddar and a green jalapeño slice peeking through.

photos.name: img-7508
photos.summary: Side profile of loaf 1 on the copper rack with the stainless fridge and hallway in the background — very dark crust with heavy cheese-caramelization pooled around the base, squat dome consistent with the denser rise.

photos.name: img-7515
photos.summary: Loaf 2 held on the copper rack in front of two blinded windows — taller, rounder dome than loaf 1, flour-dusted crown with green jalapeño slices and pools of golden cheddar visible across the entire side.

photos.name: img-7516
photos.summary: Tilted three-quarter view of loaf 2 on the copper rack near the windows, forearm and tattoo visible holding the rack — prominent jalapeño slices peek through caramelized cheese windows, with a clean flour-dusted top showing the better rise.

photos.name: img-7517
photos.summary: Crumb shot of loaf 2 held in hand against a grey wall — two halves shown side by side, moderately open crumb packed with green jalapeño chunks and large molten cheddar pockets, reflecting the heavy cheese load from this bake.
